question: Why does American television run at 59.94 fields a second instead of a round 60?
answer: Because of colour, in 1953. The colour signal rode on a second wave near 3.58 MHz, which clashed with the 4.5 MHz sound carrier to make visible patterns. Retuning the sound would have broken existing black-and-white sets, so engineers slowed the picture by 0.1%. Editing software still offers 29.97 frames a second.
move: Compatibility with what people already own usually beats elegance.
reference: Poynton, Digital Video and HD: Algorithms and Interfaces, 2nd edition, Morgan Kaufmann, 2012
